rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a slope or incline, including a gentle one.

example.english: The glacis ahead isn't very steep, so you can push the cart up it.
example.traditional: 前面嗰段斜坡唔算斜，推住架車行都得。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 go2 dyun6 ce3 bo1 m4 syun3 ce4 teoi1 zyu6 gaa3 ce1 haang4 dou1 dak1
